title: Fundamental Rights (School Intro)
description: A simple introduction to fundamental rights in Nepal's Constitution.

sections.title: What Are Fundamental Rights?
sections.content: Fundamental rights are basic protections the Constitution gives to every person or citizen. They make sure people are treated fairly and have freedoms like speech and equality.

sections.title: Why They Matter
sections.content: These rights help protect people from unfair rules and abuse. They also help make sure everyone has chances to learn, speak, and live with dignity.

summary: Fundamental rights keep people safe and free.
They belong to everyone in protected categories.
